description:
TAX LOT 5, IN TAX BLOCK 895, ON THE OFFICIAL TAX MAP OF THE CITY OF NEWARK.
THE UPSET PRICE IS: $832,890.21
ALL THAT (THOSE) CERTAIN LOT(S), TRACK(S) OR PARCELL(S) OF LAND, WITH THE BUILDINGS AND IMPROVEMENTS THEREON ERECTED, SITUATE, LYING AND BEING IN THE CITY OF NEWARK, COUNTY OF NEWARK, COUNTY OF ESSEX, AND STATE OF NEW JERSEY AND IS BOUNDED AND DESCRIBED AS FOLLOWS:
BEGINNING AT A POINT AT THE INTERSECTION OF NORTHEASTERLY SIDE OF TICHENOR STREET WITH THE SOUTHEASTERLY SIDE OF MCCARTER HGHWAY AND FROM THENCE RUNNING
1. ALONG THE SAID SOUTHEASTERLY SIDE OF MCCARTER HIGHWAY ON A CURVE TO THE RIGHT HAVING A RADIUS OF 1112.09 FEET A DISTANCE OF 137.48 FEET; THENCE
2. SOUTH 30 DEGREES 21 MINUTES WEST, 47.25 FEET; THENCE
3. SOUTH 46 DEGREES 10 MINUTES EAST, 22.43 FEET; THENCE
4. NORTH 31 DEGREES 43 MINUTES EAST, 8.85 FEET; THENCE
5. SOUTH 60 DEGREES 00 MINUTES EAST, 93.50 FEET; THENCE
6. SOUTH 30 DEGREES 00 MINUTES WEST, 87.33 FEET TO A POINT IN THE SAID NORTHEASTERLY SIDE OF TICHENOR STREET; AND THENCE
7. ALONG THE SAID NORTHWESTERLY SIDE OF TICHENOR STREET, NORTH 60 DEGREES 00 MINTUES WEST, 156.33 FEET TO THE POINT AND LACE OF BEGINNING.
